login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_username, password=spotify_password)

def is_rnb(genre):

    g = str(genre).lower()

    sid = rec['song_id']

    if release_date:

            rel_year = None
    if rel_year == current_year and is_rnb(genre):

            'song_id': sid,
            'title': song.get('title'),
            'release_date': release_date,
            'genre': genre,

spotify_username = 'caiburc@gmail.com'
spotify_password = creds['password']
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_username, password=spotify_password)['access_token']

# Fetch all recommendations
all_recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20

    if not page:
        break
    all_recs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

    if genre is None:
        return False

matches=[]
